edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against messiDev/messiCommunity by the only modifier, the sole authorization gate for privileged functions.
messiDev is the expected msg.sender identity checked in the only modifier.
messiCommunity is the expected msg.sender identity checked in the only modifier.
setTransferable is gated by only(messiDev).
disableSetTransferable is gated by only(messiDev).
setmessiDevAddress is gated by only(messiDev).
setmessiCommunityAddress is gated by only(messiCommunity).
setDurationOfLock is gated by only(messiCommunity).
approveMintTokens is gated by only(messiCommunity).
withdrawMintTokens is gated by only(messiCommunity).
mintTokens is gated by only(messiDev).
finishMinting is gated by only(messiDev).
msg.sender indexes balances[msg.sender] in transfer arithmetic.
msg.sender indexes allowed[_from][msg.sender] in transferFrom arithmetic.
msg.sender owns the allowance slot written by approve.
msg.sender balance is debited inside the batch transfer loop.
balances mapping values feed the subtraction/addition in transfer.
transfer writes the updated balances back to storage.
balances of _from and _to feed the arithmetic in transferFrom.
transferFrom writes updated balances back to storage.
allowed[_from][msg.sender] is read and decreased in transferFrom.
transferFrom writes the reduced allowance back to storage.
approve reads and overwrites the allowed mapping entry.
lockTokens[_owner].value is read and incremented in approveMintTokens.
approveMintTokens writes the new locked value and lock block number.
totalSupply is read for the overflow and cap checks in approveMintTokens.
totalSupplyCap bounds curTotalSupply + _amount in approveMintTokens.
durationOfLock is added to the current block number for the new lock time.
lockTokens[_owner].value is decreased in withdrawMintTokens.
withdrawMintTokens writes the reduced locked value and reset block number.
totalSupply is read for the overflow and cap checks in mintTokens.
totalSupplyCap bounds totalSupply + _amount in mintTokens.
mintTokens assigns the increased total supply.
mintTokens credits the minted amount into balances[_owner].
mintTokens clears lockTokens[_owner] value and block number.
transferable flag is read by the canTransfer guard protecting transfer.
transferable flag is read by the canTransfer guard protecting transferFrom.
canSetTransferable gates whether transferable can still be modified.
finishMinting sets mintingFinished to true.
canMint modifier reads mintingFinished before approveMintTokens state changes.
canMint modifier reads mintingFinished before mintTokens state changes.
setmessiDevAddress overwrites the messiDev controller address.
setmessiCommunityAddress overwrites the messiCommunity controller address.
TIMETHRESHOLD is the lower bound required by setDurationOfLock.
setDurationOfLock writes the new durationOfLock value.
transfer executes the guarded balance arithmetic.
transferFrom executes the guarded balance and allowance arithmetic.
approveMintTokens executes manual overflow and cap arithmetic.
withdrawMintTokens executes manual subtraction arithmetic.
mintTokens executes supply and balance arithmetic.
transferForMultiAddresses executes balance arithmetic per loop iteration.
getCurrentBlockNumber supplies the block.number used for lock expiration.
Lock expiration check gates whether mintTokens may proceed.
transfer delegates checked subtraction to SafeMath.sub.
transfer delegates checked addition to SafeMath.add.
transferFrom delegates checked subtraction to SafeMath.sub.
transferFrom delegates checked addition to SafeMath.add.
_value parameter is the amount subtracted/added in transfer.
_to parameter is the destination credited in transfer.
_from parameter is the source debited in transferFrom.
_value parameter is the amount debited and deducted from allowance.
_to parameter is the destination credited in transferFrom.
_owner parameter indexes the balances mapping read by balanceOf.
_spender parameter is the allowance key written by approve.
_value parameter is stored as the new allowance in approve.

_messiDev parameter becomes the new controller address.
_messiCommunity parameter becomes the new community address.
_durationOfLock parameter becomes the new lock duration.
_owner parameter keys the lockTokens and balances entries in approveMintTokens.
_amount parameter is added to lockTokens and validated against the cap.
_owner parameter keys the lockTokens entry in withdrawMintTokens.
_amount parameter is subtracted from the locked value.
_owner parameter is the mint recipient in mintTokens.
_addresses array supplies recipients in the batch transfer loop.
_amounts array supplies the amounts subtracted/added per iteration.
Cached previous locked value participates in the overflow-checked addition.
Cached totalSupply is used in the overflow and cap comparisons.
Cached owner balance is used in the overflow sanity check.
Current block number plus duration is stored as the lock expiration.
Cached previous locked value is reduced by the withdrawn amount.
Copied locked amount is minted into supply and balance.
Cached totalSupply is used in the overflow and cap comparisons.
Cached owner balance is used in the overflow sanity check.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to of transfer is the recipient credited in the balance arithmetic; merge into arith_transfer_balances.
Parameter _value of transfer is the amount moved by the balance arithmetic; merge into arith_transfer_balances.
Parameter _owner of balanceOf only indexes the returned balance; merge into balanceOf.
Parameter _from of transferFrom is the debited source in the allowance/balance arithmetic; merge into arith_transferFrom_balances.
Parameter _value of transferFrom is subtracted from balance and allowance; merge into arith_transferFrom_balances.
Parameter _to of transferFrom is credited in the balance arithmetic; merge into arith_transferFrom_balances.
Parameter _spender of approve only keys the allowance slot; merge into approve.
Parameter _value of approve is written verbatim as the allowance; merge into approve.
Parameter _transferable directly sets the transferable flag; merge into setTransferable.
Parameter _messiDev directly overwrites the controller address; merge into setmessiDevAddress.
Parameter _messiCommunity directly overwrites the community address; merge into setmessiCommunityAddress.
Parameter _durationOfLock directly sets the lock duration; merge into setDurationOfLock.
Parameter _owner keys the lockTokens/balances entries in the mint approval arithmetic; merge into arith_approveMintTokens.
Parameter _amount is the value checked against the cap and added to locked tokens; merge into arith_approveMintTokens.
Parameter _owner keys the lockTokens entry reduced by withdrawMintTokens; merge into arith_withdrawMintTokens.
Parameter _amount is subtracted from the locked value; merge into arith_withdrawMintTokens.
Parameter _owner is the mint recipient whose balance and lock are updated; merge into arith_mintTokens.
Parameter _addresses only supplies recipients to the batch loop arithmetic; merge into arith_multiTransfer.
Parameter _amounts supplies the amounts moved by the batch loop arithmetic; merge into arith_multiTransfer.
Local cache previousLockTokens is only used by the mint approval overflow check; merge into arith_approveMintTokens.
Local cache curTotalSupply is only used by the supply cap check; merge into arith_approveMintTokens.
Local cache previousBalanceTo is only used by the overflow sanity check; merge into arith_approveMintTokens.
Local curBlockNumber plus durationOfLock produces the stored lock time; merge into arith_approveMintTokens.
Local cache previousLockTokens is only used by the withdrawal subtraction; merge into arith_withdrawMintTokens.
Local _amount copied from lockTokens is minted by mintTokens; merge into arith_mintTokens.
Local cache curTotalSupply is only used by the supply cap check; merge into arith_mintTokens.
Local cache previousBalanceTo is only used by the overflow sanity check; merge into arith_mintTokens.
Loop counter i only drives the batch transfer balance arithmetic; merge into arith_multiTransfer.
Local result c is the output of the SafeMath.add overflow assertion; merge into safeAdd.
Parameter a is consumed only by the SafeMath.add overflow check; merge into safeAdd.
Parameter b is consumed only by the SafeMath.add overflow check; merge into safeAdd.
